service.ml: ഗാർഹിക തൊഴിലാളിയുടെ വർക്ക് പെർമിറ്റ് വിവരങ്ങൾ പുതുക്കൽ

about: Correct or update the details on a domestic worker's work permit.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employer's passport and Emirates ID must be valid
Resident employers or investors need a valid residence permit
Worker's passport valid for at least 3 months
documents: Employer's passport copy (citizens include the unified number page)
Worker's passport copy and colour photo
fees: Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
